patronOf.en-US: Patron of children and of work
patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro das crianças e do trabalho

prayerExcerpt.en-US: This is the one who was not deserted by God on the day of struggle.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Este é o homem que Deus não abandonou no dia do combate.

meta.face: A boy of fourteen, visibly a boy and not a young man, with a round face still holding childhood fullness — a smooth, rounded forehead, round, soft cheeks, a short, straight nose with a small rounded tip, large, round dark-brown eyes under straight, thick dark brows, a small dimpled chin and a small mouth with the faint hint of a smile; a light olive, sun-warmed Mediterranean complexion; thick, dark-brown hair in short, tight curls close to the head; no beard; a brave, candid gaze lifted a little upward.
meta.basis: The traditional Passio makes him a Phrygian orphan brought to Rome and beheaded at fourteen on the Via Aurelia; later statues such as the one in Barcelona Cathedral (Wikipedia lead image) show a curly-haired boy in a tunic and cloak with a book and palm. The card follows those, not the medieval soldier type.
